arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ ،
وَ لَا يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِي أَمْرِكَ ،
وَ لَا يَغْفُلُونَ عَنِ الْوَلَهِ إِلَيْكَ
وَ الرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلَائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ .
وَ الرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ ،
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ، وَ عَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ ،
وَالَّذِينَ لَا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دُءُوبٍ ،
وَ لَا إِعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوبٍ وَ لَا فُتُورٌ ،
وَ لَا تَشْغَلُهُمْ عَنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ الشَّهَوَاتُ ،
وَ لَا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَلَاتِ .
الْخُشَّعُ الْأَبْصَارِ فَلَا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إِلَيْكَ ،
الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ ،
وَ الْمُتَوَاضِعُونَ دُونَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ جَلَالِ كِبْرِيَائِكَ
وَ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إِذَا نَظَرُوا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَبَدْنَاكَ حَقَّ عِبَادَتِكَ .
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ عَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ ،
وَ حُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إِلَى رُسُلِكَ ، وَ الْمُؤْتَمَنِينَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
وَ قَبَائِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ ،
وَ أَغْنَيْتَهُمْ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَ الشَّرَابِ بِتَقْدِيسِكَ ،
وَ خُزَّانِ الْمَطَرِ وَ زَوَاجِرِ السَّحَابِ
وَ الَّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ الرُّعُودِ ،
وَ إِذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السَّحَابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ .
وَ الْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ إِذَا نَزَلَ ،
وَ كَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الْأَمْطَارِ وَ عَوَالِجُهَا
وَ رُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ
وَ مُنْكَرٍ وَ نَكِيرٍ ، وَ رُومَانَ فَتَّانِ الْقُبُورِ ،
وَ مَالِكٍ ، وَ الْخَزَنَةِ ، وَ رِضْوَانَ ، وَ سَدَنَةِ الْجِنَانِ .
وَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ ،
وَ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ
وَ الزَّبَانِيَةِ الَّذِينَ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ
وَ مَنْ أَوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ ، وَ لَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ ،
وَ سُكَّانِ الْهَوَاءِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ الْمَاءِ
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ يَومَ يَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَ شَهِيدٌ
وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلَى كَرَامَتِهِمْ
اللَّهُمَّ وَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ
فَصَلِّ عَلَيْنَا بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيهِمْ ،
transliteration: Allāhumma wa ḥamalatu ‘arshika-lladhīna lā yafturūna min tasbīḥik,
Fa-ṣalli ‘alayhim, wa ‘alā-l-malā’ikati-lladhīna min dūnihim min sukkāni samāwātik,
Wa-lladhīna lā tadkhuluhum sa’matun min du’ūb,
wa lā i‘yā’un min lughūbin wa lā futūr,
alladhīna qad ṭālat raghbatuhum fīmā ladayk,
Wa-lladhīna yaqūlūna idhā naẓarū ilā jahannama tazfiru ‘alā ahli ma‘ṣiyatika subḥānaka mā ‘abadnāka ḥaqqa ‘ibādatik.
wa ḥummāli-l-ghaybi ilā rusulik, wa-l-mu’tamanīna ‘alā waḥyik
wa idhā sabaḥat bihi ḥafīfatu-s-saḥābi-ltama‘at ṣawā‘iqu-l-burūq.
wa kayla mā taḥwīhi lawā‘iju-l-amṭāri wa ‘awālijuhā
wa Munkarin wa Nakīr, wa Rūmāna fattāni-l-qubūr,
wa Mālikin, wa-l-khazanah, wa Riḍwāna, wa sadanati-l-jinān.
Wa man awhamnā dhikrahu, wa lam na‘lam makānahu mink,
Fa-ṣalli ‘alayhim yawma ya’tī kullu nafsin ma‘ahā sā’iqun wa shahīd
Wa ṣalli ‘alayhim ṣalātan tazīduhum karāmatan ‘alā karāmatihim
Allāhumma wa idhā ṣallayta ‘alā malā’ikatika wa rusulik
fa-ṣalli ‘alaynā bimā fataḥta lanā min ḥusni-l-qawli fīhim,
translation: O God, and the bearers of Your Throne, who do not slacken from Your glorification,
nor weary of Your sanctification,
nor tire of Your worship,
nor prefer falling short over diligence in Your command,
nor are they heedless of their fervent devotion to You.
And Israfil, the owner of the Horn,
the one standing alert, who awaits Your permission,
and the advent of the Command,
so he may awaken with the Blast the prostrate hostages of the graves.
And Mika'il, possessor of high station with You,
and lofty rank in Your obedience.
And Jibril, the trustworthy over Your revelation,
the obeyed among the inhabitants of Your heavens,
the firmly established with You,
the one brought near to You.
And the Spirit who is over the angels of the veils.
And the Spirit who is from Your command.
So bless them, and the angels below them among the inhabitants of Your heavens,
and the people of trustworthiness over Your messages.
And those whom weariness from exertion does not enter,
nor fatigue from toil, nor languor,
nor do desires distract them from Your glorification,
nor does the oversight of heedlessness cut them off from Your magnification.
Their gazes are humbled, so they do not attempt to look at You,
their chins are lowered,
those whose longing for what is with You has extended,
the ardent in remembrance of Your bounties,
and the humble before Your might and the majesty of Your grandeur.
And those who say, when they look at Hell roaring at the people of Your disobedience, 'Glory be to You! We have not worshipped You as You deserve to be worshipped.'
So bless them and the spiritual ones among Your angels,
and the people of nearness to You,
and the bearers of the unseen to Your messengers, and those entrusted with Your revelation.
And the tribes of angels whom You have chosen for Yourself,
and whom You have made needless of food and drink through Your sanctification,
and whom You have housed in the inner layers of Your heavens.
And those who are on its (the heaven's) borders
when the command descends for the fulfillment of Your promise.
And the treasurers of rain and the drivers of clouds.
And he by the sound of whose driving the rumble of thunder is heard,
and when the swift clouds float with it, the flashes of lightning sparkle.
And the escorts of snow and hail,
and those who descend with the drops of rain when it falls,
and the overseers of the treasuries of the winds,
and those entrusted with the mountains so they do not shift.
And those whom You have informed of the weights of waters,
and the measure of what the downpours and torrents of rain contain.
And Your messengers from the angels to the people of the earth
with the detested affliction that descends
and the beloved prosperity.
And the noble, righteous scribes (angels),
and the noble, recording guardians,
and the angel of death and his assistants,
and Munkar and Nakir, and Ruman, the tester of the graves,
and those who circumambulate the Frequented House,
and Malik, and the treasurers (of Hell), and Ridwan, and the keepers of the Gardens (Paradise).
And those who do not disobey God in what He commands them,
and do what they are commanded.
And those who say, 'Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured.'
And excellent is the final home!
And the Zabaniyah (angels of Hell), who, when it is said to them,
'Seize him and fetter him, then drive him to Hellfire,'
they rush him swiftly, and do not grant him respite.
And those whose mention we may have missed, and whose station with You we do not know,
and with what task You have entrusted them.
And the inhabitants of the air, the earth, and the water,
and those among them who are [set] over the creation.
So bless them on the Day when every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
And bless them with a blessing that increases them in honor upon their honor,
and in purity upon their purity.
O God, and when You have blessed Your angels and Your messengers,
and conveyed to them our blessings upon them,
then bless us for the good words You have opened for us concerning them,
Indeed, You are Bountiful, Generous.
